notes.title: Our Journey playtest phase starts!
notes.content:
Hey !

We need feedbacks ! Help us make a better game.

With this first build we want to check if the onboarding is right.

You can give us feedbacks in the game by clicking the Feedback button.
You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/Ju4VpNTtUn]Discord[/url] to discuss about the game, give more feedbacks and follow day by day developement updates.
